goal: Reception answers the same guest questions about check-in, transfers and breakfast many times a day, and messages sent at night wait until morning. We'll build a bot that answers guests around the clock in English, German and Russian, and passes booking and transfer requests to your team.
solution_items: A Telegram bot that answers frequent guest questions in three languages
Transfer requests collected in the chat and logged in Google Sheets
Booking requests forwarded to reception with guest details
An admin page where staff update answers and opening hours

relevant_cases.why_relevant: We built a booking bot that hands requests to front desk staff.
We built a bilingual client-facing system for a logistics company that cut routine questions to staff.

stages.name: Bot and answers
stages.content: FAQ answers in three languages based on your hotel info, transfer requests logged in Google Sheets, alerts for reception

stages.name: Launch
stages.content: Testing with real guest questions together with reception, staff training, handover of source code and access

next_step.start: next week after the contract is signed
client_needs: Access to the transfers Google Sheet

optional_blocks.detail: FAQ answers in English only, with transfers added once the bot proves useful
optional_blocks.reason: The budget is fixed before the season, so a smaller first release lowers the risk.
